newsitem.title: USA: CNET chief oper officer holds 23.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: CNET chief oper officer holds 23.9 pct.

text.p: Shelby Bonnie, executive vice president, chief operating officer and chief financial officer of CNET Inc, said Thursday he held a 23.9 percent stake in the company, or 3,172,085 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Bonnie said the stake included 92,500 shares purchased between August 5 and August 29. The filing did not indicate how much Bonnie paid for the shares.
Bonnie said the shares were acquired for personal investment purposes.
